runs.question: How long do CFO Act agencies have to publish an AI strategy under the OMB AI memos?

answer.text:
Under the most recent memo, OMB M-25-21, CFO Act agencies have 180 days. The earlier memo, M-24-10, gave them 365 days.

- **M-25-21 (April 2025): 180 days.** The memo says within 180 days of the issuance of this memorandum, each CFO Act agency must develop an AI Strategy for removing barriers to responsible AI use. Agencies must also make the strategy public, using a template OMB will provide.
- **M-24-10 (March 2024): 365 days.** That memo required each CFO Act agency must develop and release publicly on the agency's website a strategy within 365 days of issuance.

M-25-21 is the later memo, so its 180-day deadline is the one that applies. I did not find explicit language in either document saying that M-25-21 rescinds or replaces M-24-10, so that conclusion is my inference from the dates. Also, the Department of Defense and elements of the Intelligence Community are excluded from the strategy requirement, per the footnote in M-24-10.
